title: The Heavenly Twins
description: Published in 1893 and the central English New Woman novel: the boy-and-girl twins Angelica and Diavolo, three marriages, and the destruction of women by the sexual double standard. The last book is narrated by Dr Galbraith, whom Evadne marries after Colquhoun's death.

title: 'Marriage' (1888)
